content.value: A transmission tower on a level ground gives a minimum clearance of 8 meters (10) for its lowest conductor with sag of 10 m for a span of 300 m. If the same tower is to be used over a slope of 1 in 15, find the minimum ground clearance obtained for the same span, same conductor and same weather-conditions.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
